text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: 17 Japanese files, M2 Ultra; the Japanese-only rows ran with another GPU client resident, so their speeds are floors. Whisper's 18.0-22.0x run range is not drawn.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Neither Japanese-only engine is more accurate than Voxtral, so they do not change the default; parakeet wins only on speed. Source: engines.md.
